instructions: Yume is a browser extension (extension/, MV3, no build step) and a local Flask server (server/, port 5001, 127.0.0.1 only) that downloads a video's audio, transcribes it with faster-whisper (whisper.cpp on Vulkan for AMD), translates it with a local LLM and shows subtitles over the video. The CLI lives in yume/. CLAUDE.md holds the project's conventions: hold every change to them. Focus on correctness first: threads (job.lock, _state.transcribe_lock), what a viewer sees on screen, the cache (config/yume_cache.db) and what happens on a second run of the same video. Then security: the API token, Host and CORS checks, subprocess arguments, downloads checked by SHA-256. Anything that changes subtitle text must be measured on the gold set first (tests/gold/RESULTS.md). Many tracked files use CRLF line endings: a diff that rewrites every line of a file is an ending change, flag it. Write comments in plain English, say what goes wrong and when, and skip praise.

rules.rule: Dynamic content put into innerHTML must go through _escapeHtml() (it escapes quotes). Subtitle text is set with textContent, never innerHTML.

Every server endpoint requires the per-session API token except /health. CORS is only for chrome-extension:// and moz-extension:// origins, and the Host header must be localhost (DNS-rebinding defence). The server binds 127.0.0.1 only.

A new server route must be added to _ALLOWED_PATH in extension/js/background.js, or the extension cannot reach it. Only background.js resolves the server URL (_whisperUrl()); content scripts never hardcode localhost:5001.
Never shell=True or os.system(). Subprocesses take explicit argv lists. CLI code (yume/) runs commands through the _run() wrapper from yume/utils.py.
A video URL is validated before it reaches yt-dlp or ffmpeg (no argument injection; a URL starting with '-' must never become an option).
Never byte ranges, seeks or other tricks on a stream URL to get around a site's limits or bot detection: the preview is a second ordinary download through a pipe (yt-dlp -o - | ffmpeg).
Never kill a process on a port unless it is Yume's own: kill_port_process (yume/ports.py) asks otherwise.
Binaries and models Yume downloads are checked against a SHA-256 pin (server/whisper_cpp.json, yume/hardware.TRANSLATORS, llama.cpp release assets) before use; a mismatch deletes the file and fails.

Nothing in yume/ imports from pocket_yume.py. Shared constants (version, paths, platform flags, BACKEND_INFO, download URLs) are defined once in yume/constants.py. A new CLI command is one entry in yume/cli.COMMANDS. Whisper model metadata lives only in yume/hardware.WHISPER_MODELS, multilingual models only (no distil-* or *.en).
Every key in DEFAULT_CONFIG is read by app code (TestDeadConfigDetection enforces it). requirements.txt and LLAMA_SERVER_DEPS pin exact versions with ==, except yt-dlp and llama-cpp-python.
Downloads live in yume_* temp dirs and are deleted with _audio.remove_temp() in a finally block.

A change to what Whisper hears or which lines are shown (decode parameters, filters, line cleaning, regions, alignment) needs a measurement on the gold set recorded in tests/gold/RESULTS.md, or a reason it cannot change subtitle text.
A version bump changes all three sources together: VERSION in yume/constants.py, SERVER_VERSION in server/_state.py and "version" in extension/manifest.json, plus the README badge.
Keep each file's line endings: many tracked files are CRLF. .sh and .command files must stay LF (.gitattributes).
